reports.title: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Loss of $1.63 a share, narrower than estimates; revenue $9.4m below; 2026 R&D and royalty guides cut, year-end cash seen above top of range
results: Revenue, all non-cash royalties, fell to $9.4m from $11.8m a year ago.
The net loss widened to $55.7m from $35.5m as Phase 3 spending on rezpegaldesleukin (REZPEG) lifted R&D to $44.1m; the loss per share was smaller because of many more shares in issue.
G&A rose to $24.6m from $16.1m, mainly on higher legal costs.
All three ZENITH AD Phase 3 trials in atopic dermatitis are now under way; the ZENITH AA alopecia trial is set to start in December, earlier than planned.
Cash and investments were $952.9m at the end of September, with no debt.

guidance.summary: The press release gives no outlook, but on the call Nektar cut its 2026 R&D and royalty revenue guides and said year-end cash should be above $840m, the top of its earlier $815–840m range. G&A guidance of about $65m was kept.

points: About 1,500 patients will take part in the three ZENITH AD trials; one now tests REZPEG with steroid creams after regulator feedback.
Atopic dermatitis results are expected in summer 2028, with a US filing targeted for the end of 2029.
The roughly 850-patient alopecia trial starts next month, with data expected in 2029.
Management called its financial position strong and enough to fund the registration programmes.
Further readouts: off-treatment eczema data in Q1 2027, and Type 1 diabetes and vitiligo data around late 2027 or early 2028.
call.source: Q3 2026 earnings call transcript — The Motley Fool, 13 Nov 2026; prior ranges from Earnings Whispers preview via Finviz, 4 Nov 2026

watch: Enrolment pace in the ZENITH AD and ZENITH AA Phase 3 trials.
52-week off-treatment eczema data due in Q1 2027.
Year-end cash against the above-$840m guide and the ongoing legal costs.
